explanation.value: Every triple says the entity gains access to whatever has access to the object: owning a camera, belonging to a group, or being a subgroup all point from the entity to the object. Reverse those edges: for each object, list the entities that hold it. A BFS from the camera along reversed edges reaches every group and user that holds the camera through any chain. Users are recognised as entities that appear in cameraOwner or groupMember triples. Collect the visited users and sort them. A visited set handles cycles.
